body:
Back from the other discussion, here are my current thoughts:

* We keep the `refinementList` as a widget (me suggesting removing it was a misunderstanding on my part)
* We remove the `singleRefine` option form the `refinementList` widget (we keep it in the component). We already have the `menu` widget for that. Maybe this is not the best name, but we can work on finding a better name on another issue (`singleSelection`, `radioList`, ...)
